report.title: I have a Text panel in HTML mode with a button in it
report.body: I have a Text panel in HTML mode with a button in it. It used to show and work, but after upgrading, the button no longer appears or works on the dashboard.

report.title: On a dashboard with rows that repeat for each value of a data source…
report.body: On a dashboard with rows that repeat for each value of a data source variable, panels that use math expressions show the same numbers in every row, the numbers from the first row, even though the row titles show the right data source. Panels without expressions show the right data per row. This worked before upgrading.

report.title: When I open a dashboard in kiosk mode, there's a black empty bar across the…
report.body: When I open a dashboard in kiosk mode, there's a black empty bar across the top of the dashboard. This wasn't there before the update.
